about: Study 27 / the About: the year each poem of v2/data.json was written by, from the earliest credible evidence, and how that was found. Gathered 9 Nov 2026 from the book manuscript as submitted (Aug 2022), his public posts, his own dated documents and recordings, the poem films, and his writing library (a file is trusted by its creation date only when fewer than 8 files were created that day; busier days are migrations). The evidence is kept privately; only the year and the how reach the page. A poem with no credible evidence is in undated, with why.
